posts.title: Our new website, online ordering and members’ app
posts.summary: loughorrfc.site is the club’s new home online: club news, the clubhouse menu with ordering to your table or for collection, and the members’ app at member.loughorrfc.site.
posts.html:
Welcome to loughorrfc.site, the new home of Loughor RFC online.

You can see the clubhouse menu, live from the bar’s own till, and order to your table when you are in the club, or order ahead for collection and pay at the bar when you pick it up.

Members’ cards now live in the Loughor RFC app and at member.loughorrfc.site. Sign in with your email address and the code we send you. At the bar, hold your Android phone or Wear OS watch near the reader, or show the QR code from the app or Apple Wallet, and your members’ discount is applied.

Club news will appear here and on our Facebook page and X (@LoughorRFC).
posts.author: club

posts.title: Juniors and youth: come and play for the Blues
posts.summary: Loughor RFC runs age-group rugby from under 6 up to youth. New players, parents and volunteers are always welcome at Villa Field.
posts.html:
Loughor RFC has been playing rugby since 1882, and the junior section is how the club keeps going: age-group rugby from under 6 up to youth, with qualified coaches.

New players are welcome at every age, whether they have played before or not. Parents and volunteers who would like to help are just as welcome.

Call the club on 01792 894109 or message us on Facebook to find out when your age group trains this season.
